doc.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: Hollywood Bowl tribute and rock sessions
summary: Upcoming tribute concert and doing rock record sessions.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Terrific. Anything that you would like to talk about that I haven’t thought to ask? The floor is open.
No. It’s great, you said everything. I’ll be at the Hollywood Bowl on September 15th, but that won’t matter in the archives.
Yeah, a tribute to Quincy Jones and Johnny Mandel and Hank Mancini.
Ah. What kind of ensemble do they put together for that? Is it a studio orchestra?
No, John Clayton/Jeff Hamilton Band, a big jazz band. And Shirley Horn will be there and Plas Johnson, a great player. I forget who else, but other people too, so that’ll be nice.
Did you ever play on rock stuff?
Yeah. I’ve done some records and they called me in and just had me add to it the trumpet, and I don’t know what happened with it.
So I’ve done anything. Anything for money.
Oh Leon Russell, yeah I did a lot of stuff with Leon. Love him.
